summary_en: Sanki Service will cancel 900,000 treasury shares, reducing outstanding shares by 0.8% to 112,099,700 shares effective March 31, 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Sanki Service Corporation announced the cancellation of 900,000 treasury shares. The cancellation will become effective on March 31, 2025, reducing the number of issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares) from 112,999,700 to 112,099,700 shares, representing a reduction of approximately 0.8% of issued shares.
